input: Book a backstage tour at the local theater

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Backstage tours vary widely — some cover just the stage and wings, others include dressing rooms, technical booths, props storage, fly systems, etc. Knowing what areas must be included shapes which theaters to target and what to request.
The number of people and who they are (adults, children, mixed group) affects availability, pricing, minimum/maximum group size requirements, and whether a private or public tour is needed.
The specific theater — or whether one has already been chosen — determines the exact booking process, contact details, and feasibility entirely.
A preferred date or date range directly governs which theaters and tour slots are even viable options.
Whether the user wants a guided tour led by staff, a self-guided option, or a tour tied to attending a live performance changes what to book and how.
The reason for the tour — personal interest, a school/group outing, a special occasion — influences the tone of the request and any special accommodations to ask for.
Understanding the budget ceiling helps filter out theaters with paid premium tours and sets expectations on what is realistic to pursue.

gold.taskTitle: Book a backstage tour at local theater
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange a backstage tour at a local theater, which requires identifying the right venue, timing, group details, and how to make the booking happen.

questions.title: Which specific theater do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify whether the user already has a particular theater chosen, or needs help selecting one from local options.

questions.title: What areas of the theater must the tour cover?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a full backstage experience (dressing rooms, fly system, tech booth, props) or just the stage and wings.

questions.title: How many people are joining the tour?
questions.description: Determine group size to assess private vs. public tour options and any minimum/maximum group requirements.

questions.title: What date or timeframe are you aiming for?
questions.description: Establish the target date or window so available slots and theater schedules can be checked.

questions.title: Should the tour be guided by theater staff or self-guided?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants a staff-led tour, a self-guided walk-through, or a tour bundled with watching a live performance.

questions.title: What is the main reason or occasion for this tour?
questions.description: Understand the purpose — personal curiosity, school trip, birthday, professional research — to tailor the request and any special accommodations.

questions.title: Do you have a maximum budget per person in mind?
questions.description: Identify any budget ceiling to filter options between free community theater tours and paid premium experiences.
